items.title: EtihadWE完成RAKWA污水处理厂3.26亿美元融资交割
items.title_en: EtihadWE achieves financial close on USD326m RAKWA sewage treatment plant
items.summary: Etihad Water and Electricity宣布价值3.26亿美元（约12亿迪拉姆）的RAKWA独立污水处理厂项目完成融资交割。项目合作方包括TAQA Water Solutions与Saur Group，初期污水处理能力每天60,000立方米，计划2029年初投入商业运营。融资交割不等于当天新工程授标。
items.summary_en: EtihadWE reached financial close for the USD326 million (AED1.2 billion) RAKWA independent sewage treatment plant, partnered with TAQA Water Solutions and Saur Group. Initial treatment capacity is 60,000 cubic metres daily and commercial operations are planned for early 2029. Financial close is not a new contract award.
items.why_it_matters: 污水处理设备、机电分包、管道、泵站、施工劳务及长期运维。

items.title: SPARK与KONE签署智慧楼宇及可持续城市交通合作备忘录

items.summary: 沙迦研究、技术与创新园SPARK与电梯及自动扶梯企业KONE签署合作备忘录，探索智慧楼宇、可持续城市交通、人员流动解决方案、研发及知识交流。尚未公布独立采购金额或施工授标。
items.summary_en: Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and KONE signed an MoU to explore smart buildings, sustainable mobility, intelligent people flow, research and knowledge exchange. No specific procurement award or contract value was announced.

items.title: 沙迦商会在Big 5 Global展示本地建筑企业与可持续建造方案
items.title_en: Sharjah Chamber showcases local construction suppliers at Big 5 Global
items.sector: 建筑展会及供应商展示
items.summary: 沙迦商会及沙迦出口发展中心参加第47届Big 5 Global，通过54平方米展台展示本地建筑业企业产品、服务及可持续建造方案，促进制造商、供应商、投资者和开发商对接。展会宣传不是新签工程。
items.summary_en: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and its Export Development Centre showcased local construction companies at Big 5 Global through a 54-square-metre pavilion, facilitating supplier, investor and developer connections. No new construction contract was reported.

items.title: HSBC报告：97%受访商业领袖认为阿联酋基础设施投资具有吸引力
items.title_en: HSBC survey: 97% of business leaders view UAE infrastructure as attractive
items.summary: HSBC发布基础设施研究报告，全球受访商业领袖中97%认为阿联酋是有吸引力的基础设施投资目的地。报告汇总来自16个市场的1626名商业领袖和818名机构投资者的意见。97%为调查结果，并非已落实的投资比例。
items.summary_en: An HSBC report found 97% of surveyed global business leaders consider the UAE attractive for infrastructure investment, based on 1,626 business leaders and 818 institutional investors across 16 markets. This is survey sentiment, not executed investment.

items.title: 迪拜Majlis汇聚300名政商领袖，讨论D33下一阶段增长
items.title_en: Dubai Majlis gathers 300 public and private leaders to discuss D33 growth
items.summary: 迪拜政府经济与旅游部门和迪拜商会联合举办Dubai Majlis活动，吸引300名政府与企业决策者，围绕迪拜经济议程D33的下一阶段增长与公私合作进行交流。活动不是投资合同授标。
items.summary_en: Dubai's Department of Economy and Tourism and Dubai Chambers co-hosted Dubai Majlis with 300 government and private-sector business leaders to discuss progress under D33 and future growth. It was a dialogue event, not a contract award.

items.title: OMTC完成首次对华黄铁矿出口，发运超过2.6万吨
items.title_en: OMTC completes first pyrite export shipment to China exceeding 26,000 tonnes
items.sector: 工业矿产出口与港口物流
items.summary: 阿曼矿产贸易公司OMTC完成首批阿曼黄铁矿出口中国，通过Sohar港发运超过26,000吨。报道发布于11月25日，标志阿曼矿产出口品类进一步多元化。已完成实物出口，不是意向订单。
items.summary_en: Oman Minerals Trading Company completed its first Omani pyrite ore shipment to China, dispatching over 26,000 tonnes through Sohar Port. This is a completed physical export, not a proposed trade agreement.

items.title: Muttrah Teleferik缆车旅游项目正式全面运营
items.title_en: Muttrah Teleferik cable car begins full-scale tourism operations
items.summary: Muttrah Teleferik缆车项目正式启动全面运营，由Sabeen Investment与Muscat Municipality合作开发，线路约3公里，连接Muttrah港、山顶与Hayy Al Ward三座车站，设18个吊厢，最大运力约每小时800人，并配有商业和餐饮空间。
items.summary_en: Muttrah Teleferik began full operations. Developed by Sabeen Investment with Muscat Municipality, its 3-kilometre route links three stations, with 18 cabins and capacity of up to 800 passengers per hour, alongside retail and dining spaces.
items.why_it_matters: 旅游运营、零售餐饮、缆车维保及景区服务。

items.title: 阿曼两家独立发电公司合并获初步监管批准
items.title_en: Oman power producers' proposed merger receives preliminary regulatory approval
items.category: 拟议合并获初步监管批准
items.summary: Al Batinah Power与Al Suwadi Power拟议合并已取得阿曼公用事业监管局初步批准，仍须满足其他监管和公司程序。两家电厂Sohar II和Barka III合计合同装机容量约1,493兆瓦；该进展不是新建电站合同。
items.summary_en: The proposed merger of Al Batinah Power and Al Suwadi Power received preliminary approval from Oman’s utilities regulator, subject to further requirements and approvals. Their Sohar II and Barka III plants have aggregate contracted capacity of approximately 1,493 MW; no new plant construction was awarded.
items.why_it_matters: 电力运营、设施维护、长期购电协议及设备升级。
